description: Coarser sizing ladder used ONLY for the 12-month analytics backtest, NOT for live/manual execution. Live afternoon tasks always use config/sizing_ladder.json (the $2-base 0x-to-5x ladder) unless the dynamic risk kill-switch caps sizing to 1x. This ladder exists so backtest analytics can be run against a simpler, wider-band curve without changing anything the live task does.
tier_boundary_rule: min inclusive, max exclusive; the largest tier threshold <= actual drop wins; drop < 0.1% = 0x (no buy). 8%+ is the top 3x band.
historical_note: Backtest-only ladder. Never loaded into the live StrategyConfig. The active execution ladder remains config/sizing_ladder.json.
